may-logistic-chaos.Equilibrium_Population: Recompute exactly as1-1/r; canonical theoretical equilibrium uses algebraically equivalent(r-1)/r and can differ by rounding.
may-logistic-chaos.Deviation: Recompute Population-(1-1/r) using that exact operation order.

may-ecological-chaos-eco.Growth_Rate: Recompute r*(1-Population); this is not the3.7 parameter column.
